metadata.title: A Silent Alarm Blacked Out 55 Million People
metadata.description:
2003 blackout cut power to an estimated 55 million people. The cause: power lines sagging into trees while a frozen alarm system hid the failures from operators, so the outage cascaded.

Failure chain: Alarm software stalls → Lines sag into trees → Operators see nothing → Failures cascade → 55 million in the dark

Another reconstruction: Why Challenger Broke Apart 73 Seconds After Launch — https://youtu.be/bqTpdauhlHo

Technical references:
• Wikipedia — Northeast blackout of 2003 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northeast_blackout_of_2003
• US Department of Energy — BlackoutFinal Web (cited by Wikipedia) — https://www.energy.gov/sites/prod/files/oeprod/DocumentsandMedia/BlackoutFinal-Web.pdf

Narration uses a synthetic voice. Original animation: no archival or stock footage; reconstructions and illustrations are labelled on screen.
